entities.name: Clinic Management System
entities.description: A hybrid cloud platform designed to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records, scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals and clinics, ensuring HIPAA and GDPR compliance.

entities.name: Patient
entities.description: Patients interacting with the clinic management system for scheduling and records.

entities.name: Clinician
entities.description: Doctors and Nurses managing electronic medical records and patient care.

entities.name: Billing/Admin Staff
entities.description: Staff managing billing, admissions, and administrative tasks.

entities.name: Compliance Officer
entities.description: Officer responsible for ensuring HIPAA and GDPR compliance.

entities.name: Lab & Imaging Systems
entities.description: External systems providing laboratory and imaging data.

entities.name: Insurance Clearinghouse / External Billing Provider
entities.description: External system for insurance claims and billing processing.

entities.name: Patient Portal SPA/Mobile
entities.description: High-performance frontend user interface for patients.

entities.name: Clinician/Admin Workspace SPA
entities.description: High-performance frontend user interface for clinicians and administrative staff.

entities.name: API Gateway / BFF
entities.description: API gateway for reverse proxy, routing, and token exchange.

entities.name: Core Services Container
entities.description: Robust domain logic for core clinical services and electronic medical records.

entities.name: Integration Service Container
entities.description: HL7 FHIR translation adapters for interoperability with external lab and imaging systems.

entities.name: Audit & Compliance Logging Container
entities.description: Ensures comprehensive service mesh security and regulatory compliance logging.

entities.name: PostgreSQL & HL7 FHIR Compliant Data Stores
entities.description: Relational persistence with AES-256 encryption at rest.

entities.name: Message Broker
entities.description: Asynchronous messaging for resilient insurance claim submissions and decoupled communication.

interfaces.description: Accesses and updates electronic medical records and schedules
Monitors and audits system compliance and access logs
Exchanges clinical data and imaging results
Interacts with portal for scheduling and records
Accesses workspace for patient care and EMR

interfaces.destination: PostgreSQL & HL7 FHIR Compliant Data Stores

naming_conventions: Use Title Case for human actors and external systems
Use standard web protocols and security specifications for user interfaces
Containers are named with descriptive functional suffixes such as 'Container', 'SPA', or 'Service'
